newsitem.title: USA: Eagle shareholder files for 1.5 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Eagle shareholder files for 1.5 mln shrs.

text.p: Eagle USA Airfreight Inc said Thursday, Daniel Swannie, a shareholder and former executive officer, has offered to sell up to 1,547,758 common shares or 8.8 percent of company's outstanding shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Eagle said the company has granted the underwriters an over-allotment option to buy up to 232,164 additional shares.
The offering will be made through Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Alex. Brown & Sons Inc and Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc.

Swannie resigned as an executive officer on October 17, 1996 and as a director of the company on December 27, 1996. He had been chief operating officer since 1990 and had served as a director since May 1995.
The Houston based company is a provider of air freight forwarding and other transportation and logistics services.
